q1_preserves_001a_002a_002b.detail: All three predecessor results are preserved accurately, including verbatim numeric sub-scores cross-checked against source artifacts. Framed strictly as bounded negative environment evidence; 001A is correctly retained as environment/surface failure, NOT candidate failure. No result is upgraded, reinterpreted as stronger, or patched into a pass.

q2_forbidden_patterns_block_a1_a9.answer: names/maps all A1-A9 (pass) but one substantive completeness gap
q2_forbidden_patterns_block_a1_a9.detail: forbidden_surface_patterns.json enumerates A1-A9 by family id, each with required_detector_or_baseline + forbidden_if + rejection, plus an extra S1 underpowered-oracle family beyond the attack library. A2 lists all six graph-cache members; A5 the full value-decoder family + positive control; A6 the full degenerate set + balanced macro-F1; A8 producer/source/prediction hashes. Gap: there is no first-class forbidden family for ACTIVE budget-faithful planner saturation (budget-limited belief-state planner / greedy info-gain planner), even though the belief-state planner was the strongest fair baseline that saturated 001A (margin 0.0) and appears as a strongest-cheap-baseline in 002B. It is present in baseline_battery_minimum but is NOT elevated to a named forbidden pattern, a positive property, or an explicit promotion-gate term. See RF-1.

q3_positive_properties_constrain_or_slog.answer: mostly real constraints, one load-bearing slogan
q3_positive_properties_constrain_or_slog.detail: P001-P011 each carry a minimum_pre_run_evidence field that operationalizes them; promotion_rule pins requires_preliminary_gap_min = 0.08 and inherits band 0.03; promotion gates enumerate exhaustive_legal_query / fitted_learner / graph_cache_family_max below oracle-minus-band. These are genuine, testable constraints, not slogans. The single under-specified item is the top-level positive_grammar_summary ('oracle earns score through budget-faithful information gathering'), which is not distinguished from the budget-limited belief-state planner baseline that performs the same information gathering. Several P-properties ('expected to remain below oracle') defer numeric floors to 003A; predeclaration-before-run is required, which mitigates but does not pin all thresholds. See RF-2.

q4_weakens_baselines_or_optimize_until_p.detail: 002C strengthens the battery (adds budget_limited_belief_state_planner, greedy_information_gain planner, and closed decoders ngram_trace_lookup / belief_table / pair_count_table / trace_only_replay). It explicitly forbids manufacturing headroom by weakening/omitting/aliasing/underpowering baselines, forbids reopening or optimizing the closed MINIMAL-ENV-SPEC-001A, requires pre-registration of the strongest false explanation and A1-A9 mapping before any run, caps batch size (6-10, not 20 random variants), and routes the only-by-weakening path to the blocked stop verdict. It does NOT license per-surface optimize-until-pass. Residual (non-blocking): no cross-batch survivorship / multiple-testing control across 003A/004A/...; the program-level garden-of-forking-paths risk is ungoverned.

q5_blocked_no_valid_environment_design_g.answer: yes, needed and correctly fail-closed; likely the live outcome; but it is the only non-operationalized verdict
q5_blocked_no_valid_environment_design_g.detail: The verdict is defined and consistently wired across .md + design_constraints.json (two triggers: only-path-is-weaken-baselines; no-budget-faithful-positive-property-exists) + required_positive_properties.json + next_batch_generation_brief.json. It is genuinely needed: because the proposed positive grammar is not yet separated from the belief-state planner that already saturated 001A, blocked_no_valid_environment_design_grammar is arguably the EXPECTED outcome, not a formality. Weakness: it is the only verdict in 002C with no mechanical trigger - it relies on an agent self-reporting that no non-cheating surface exists, whereas every reject_* verdict has a checkable condition. As written it can be deferred indefinitely by running another batch. See RF-3.

required_fixes.title: Gate the active budget-faithful planner family explicitly
required_fixes.evidence: 001A strongest_fair_baseline_producer = budget_limited_belief_state_planner, score 1.0, oracle_minus_baseline_margin 0.0. 002B low_signal_underpowered_surface strongest_cheap_baseline_producer = budget_limited_belief_state_planner.
required_fixes.problem: budget_limited_belief_state_planner and greedy_information_gain planner are in next_batch_generation_brief.baseline_battery_minimum, but are absent from (a) promotion_rule_for_003a explicit *_below_oracle_minus_band gates, (b) required_positive_properties, and (c) forbidden_surface_patterns / A-family list. A 003A surface could satisfy every enumerated promotion gate while an active planner still saturates the oracle, reproducing 001A.
required_fixes.fix: Add an explicit 'planner_family_max (belief-state + greedy info-gain) below oracle-minus-band' term to promotion_rule_for_003a; add a corresponding required positive property and forbidden pattern; OR state explicitly that strongest_fair is computed as max over the FULL battery (planners included) and that the enumerated gate terms are non-exhaustive examples, not the closed gate set.

required_fixes.title: Make the positive grammar distinguish the oracle from a fair budget-limited planner
required_fixes.evidence: positive_grammar_summary: 'oracle earns signal through budget-faithful information gathering'. A budget-limited belief-state planner (a fair baseline) also performs budget-faithful information gathering and reached ceiling on 001A.
required_fixes.problem: As stated the oracle's advantage is the same capability the strongest fair baseline already has. This is the lab's recurring collapse mode (candidate behaviorally equivalent to a fair baseline: cf. ACOLB == discounted weighted least-squares; Route C candidate == exhaustive_legal_query). The positive grammar is not yet credible on this axis.
required_fixes.fix: State the specific structural source of oracle advantage that a fair budget-limited / greedy planner provably cannot capture under the same budget (e.g. a legal-but-non-plannable information asymmetry), with a pre-run argument; or lower the confidence of the positive grammar and treat blocked_no_valid_environment_design_grammar as the expected outcome.

required_fixes.title: Operationalize blocked_no_valid_environment_design_grammar
required_fixes.evidence: Every reject_* verdict has a checkable numeric condition; blocked_no_valid_environment_design_grammar has only a judgment-call trigger ('only path is weakening baselines' / 'no budget-faithful positive property exists').
required_fixes.problem: A self-reported stop verdict is vulnerable to indefinite deferral (just run another batch) and to the self-report failure mode this lab repeatedly flags. It also leaves the cross-batch multiple-testing risk ungoverned.
required_fixes.fix: Bind the stop verdict to a concrete trigger, e.g. record it when a batch all-rejects AND every rejection is a saturation/leakage/decode family (not a fixable underpowered/signal issue), and/or declare a cross-batch search budget after which continued sketch generation is itself treated as baseline-saturated search.

non_blocking_issues.title: Static-detectability honesty for A3/A4/A8/A9
non_blocking_issues.detail: PHASE0-ENVIRONMENT-ATTACK-LIBRARY-001A states A3/A4/A8/A9 have no stage-1 static detector and depend on a complete micro-probe battery. 002C's forbidden_surface_patterns present all families as generator-side rules; it should note which families are only catchable at micro-probe time, to avoid implying static-killability. Mitigated because next_batch_generation_brief requires micro-probe.

non_blocking_issues.title: Cross-batch survivorship / multiple-testing ungoverned
non_blocking_issues.detail: 002C governs a single pre-registered batch but has no family-wise error budget or total search cap across 003A/004A/... Generating sketches batch-after-batch until one passes is program-level p-hacking. Ties to RF-3.

non_blocking_issues.title: Some positive-property floors deferred, not pinned
non_blocking_issues.detail: 0.08 preliminary-gap and 0.03 band are pinned; oracle floor and passive floor are referenced as 'expected below' without numeric values in 002C. 003A's card must bind them; predeclaration-before-run is required.

non_blocking_issues.title: Two closed decoders not in the 003A battery
non_blocking_issues.detail: CLOSED_FAMILIES full_bundle_decoder and serialized_state_decoder are not explicitly listed in baseline_battery_minimum (most others, incl. belief_table / pair_count_table / ngram_trace_lookup / trace_only_replay, are). Minor; arguably covered by the six-member graph-cache family.
